Get CBA Teams

Source: R/cba.R
cba_teams.Rd

The current team list: logo, team id, club name and display name.

Endpoint: GET https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/teams/teamList

Usage

cba_teams()

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per club: logo, id, club name and display name. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py cba_teams):

col_nametypedescription
clubcharacterEmpty string on every row; meaning unverified (a club-code slot the site leaves unused).
team_cn_aliascharacterCurrent team name (Chinese short name, e.g. 'Beijing Holdings'). Names change with the sponsor, the id does not; teamId -> English glossary in cba_glossary.yaml.
team_idintegerteamId (key space: CBA clubs; 5 digits 29115-29140 for the long-standing clubs, 9 digits for newer ones (100074683 = Ningbo); stable across seasons and club renames, but the display name changes with the sponsor: 29128 = 'Zhejiang Guangsha' under many sponsor names, (Chinese text) in 2025-26). Joins getTeam / teamList and the team and player routes. Not a player or schedule id.
team_logocharacterProtocol-relative URL of the 300x300 team logo (//image.cbaleague.com/cbaleague/teamlogo/300x300/<teamId>_300.png).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cba_seasons().

See also

Other CBA Functions: cba_best_player(), cba_best_stats(), cba_game_info(), cba_game_team_four(), cba_game_team_shots(), cba_match_types(), cba_pbp(), cba_period_scores(), cba_player_advanced(), cba_player_base(), cba_player_box(), cba_player_defensive(), cba_player_extras(), cba_player_offensive(), cba_player_shots(), cba_report_status(), cba_rosters(), cba_schedule_day(), cba_schedule_month(), cba_seasons(), cba_team_basic(), cba_team_counts(), cba_team_four(), cba_team_options(), cba_team_overview(), cba_team_shots()
